title: Surreal Desert Nebula
description: A surreal desert landscape features a large flat-topped mesa in the background under a dark purple night sky filled with glowing celestial orbs, swirling galaxies, and ringed planets. In the foreground, stylized cacti and melting spherical objects with dripping colorful liquid stand on the desert floor, blending cosmic and terrestrial elements.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape at night with a large flat-topped mesa in the background, dark purple sky filled with swirling galaxies, glowing orbs, ringed planets and celestial bodies. In the foreground, melting spherical objects and cacti drip vibrant colorful liquid in teal, magenta, yellow and blue. Psychedelic cosmic desert scene with dreamlike atmosphere, vibrant dripping paint effects, otherworldly glowing elements.
